description: This is a Python source file implementing a WebRTC bot that processes audio and video streams, manages a pipeline of speech-to-text, language model, and text-to-speech services, and synchronizes images based on speech activity.

classes.name: ImageSyncAggregator
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that switches images based on whether the bot is speaking or waiting, using preloaded images.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ImageSyncAggregator with paths to speaking and waiting images, loads images, and stores their formats and bytes.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes each frame; if the frame indicates speaking start or stop, pushes corresponding images; otherwise, passes the frame along.
